title: Local core smoke
scope: Packaged headless editor checks for media, offline speech/search, projects, bins/documents, edits/history, colour/graphs, rendered frames/audio and bounded larger projects. GUI interaction, live playback, provider generation, NAS and movie export have separate coverage requirements.

cases.title: Packaged engine connection
cases.scope: Start an owned packaged headless process; create and inspect a new project through its shipped CLI.
cases.expected: The endpoint PID matches the launched process, and the created project has the exact requested name and a nonempty revision.

cases.title: Mixed-media import and local ingest
cases.scope: Register and probe eight synthetic local files, then run packaged ingest on the two editorial video fixtures with model analysis disabled. Verify terminal job results and durable source records.
cases.expected: Each identity resolves to the correct file and its probe matches the fixture. Both video assets have successful ingest operations and completion hashes matching their technical source hashes.

cases.title: Import outside the bundle parent
cases.scope: Import a fixture from a sibling directory outside the bundle parent, close and reopen the project, then resolve and probe it.
cases.expected: The same asset identity resolves to the external fixture and remains readable after reopening.

cases.title: Decode thumbnail frames
cases.scope: Generate three 320×180 thumbnail frames from the synthetic motion clip. Check midpoint times, dimensions and distinct decoded pixels. Waveforms and their display in the UI remain in IN-04.
cases.expected: Three files represent source times 1, 3 and 5 seconds in bucket order, with valid nonblank RGB pixels that change with motion.

cases.title: Insert and overwrite through editor operations
cases.scope: Place known clips, insert a copy with destination ripple, then overwrite an occupied interval with another clip. Mouse dragging remains in TL-01.
cases.expected: The inserted clip shifts the expected following content; overwrite replaces exactly the destination interval without altering the source.

cases.title: Split explicit single and multiple clips
cases.scope: Split one explicitly addressed clip, then two clips on separate tracks. Keyboard and UI selection behavior remain in TL-02.
cases.expected: The requested clip identities split at exact timeline frames, with contiguous source ranges and no changes to unrelated clips.

cases.title: Trim, slip and ripple-remove a clip
cases.scope: Trim a clip, slip its source window, then ripple-remove it. Deleting an existing empty gap and UI gestures remain in TL-03.
cases.expected: Trim changes the expected frame bounds, slip changes only the source window, and ripple removal shifts later content by the removed duration.

cases.title: Copy and move across frame rates
cases.scope: Copy a clip between 24 fps and 25 fps timelines, then move a second clip. Uses whole-second boundaries; clipboard UI and fractional rounding cases remain separate.
cases.expected: Destination frame spans are correct for 25 fps, source ranges and identities are preserved, copies leave the original, and moves remove it.

cases.title: Linked audio/video edits
cases.scope: Place linked AV, move the video with link expansion, unlink the pair, and move only the video. UI linked-selection controls remain in TL-05.
cases.expected: The linked audio follows the first move. After unlinking, the audio stays fixed while the video moves.

cases.title: Locked track rejects edits
cases.scope: Lock a track, attempt a split and a move, and inspect the unchanged project after each rejected request.
cases.expected: Both commands return a lock-specific rejection and all clip/track state remains identical.

cases.title: Twenty edits, undo and redo
cases.scope: Apply 20 known clip moves, alternating between two timelines. Undo all and redo all, checking both timelines after every step.
cases.expected: Every observed state matches the corresponding previously captured state; complete undo restores the baseline and redo restores the final edit.

cases.title: Export stills across clips and an empty interval
cases.scope: Export timeline frames from two clips and a gap; compare occupied frames to independent source decodes and repeat an earlier frame. The export dialog, playhead UI and calibrated colour matching remain manual.
cases.expected: 1080p exports correspond to their intended source frames, the empty interval is black, and repeated export of the same frame restores its pixels.

cases.title: Disable and restore a rendered clip
cases.scope: Disable a placed clip, verify its pixels disappear, then enable it and reopen the project. UI shortcuts and grade-panel toggles remain in CO-07; graph-node bypass is covered by A-RG-01.
cases.expected: Clip readback reports the requested enabled state, disabling produces a black frame, and enabling/reopening restores the original pixels.

cases.title: Render graph insertion, edit, bypass and removal
cases.scope: Insert a Gaussian blur into a known clip graph, edit its radius, bypass it, then remove it and restore the original connection. Verify graph state and rendered pixels. UI clipboard copy/paste remains in RG-01.
cases.expected: The inserted node has the expected edges; blur reduces image edge contrast, zero radius and bypass restore reference pixels, and removal restores both original graph topology and pixels.

cases.title: Checkpoint and discard project edits
cases.scope: Checkpoint a known timeline, perform another edit, then discard through the project operation. Cmd+S and the close prompt remain in LP-04.
cases.expected: The checkpoint reports the saved revision; discard restores that revision and the exact saved timeline state.

cases.title: Packaged engine restart persistence
cases.scope: Save a populated project, stop the owned headless process, launch a new process from the same package, and reopen it. Desktop launch/layout behavior remains in LP-02.
cases.expected: A different owned PID reopens the same project with identical settings, asset identities and timeline state.

cases.title: Offline speech transcription
cases.scope: Transcribe synthetic speech using the pinned, already-cached CoreML model; all downloads, embeddings and external enrichment disabled.
cases.expected: Known phrases and word timestamps match the fixture, with current source-linked transcript coverage.

cases.title: Transcript phrase and source-range search
cases.scope: Search real offline-ingested speech for words absent from its filename.
cases.expected: The expected speech asset has transcript evidence and an annotated source range.

cases.title: Filename-only search
cases.scope: Search the local project with only the name lane enabled.
cases.expected: Exactly the expected asset identity is returned with only name evidence.

cases.title: No-match filename search
cases.scope: Compare a known positive filename query with an absent token using exhaustive name search.
cases.expected: The positive control succeeds and the absent name returns no matches. Semantic relevance thresholds remain separate.

cases.title: Search becomes available after speech ingest
cases.scope: Query before and after adding and transcribing a speech video asset in the same engine process; refresh the project registry after ingest.
cases.expected: An explicit missing-index state becomes ready and the new transcript phrase becomes searchable without restarting the packaged engine.

cases.title: Project, asset and bin search scopes
cases.scope: Search a multi-timeline project, then constrain eligible assets and a bin. GUI timeline focus remains in SS-07.
cases.expected: Project search finds the media, an excluded-asset scope returns nothing, and the correct bin returns its asset.

cases.title: Bin folders and media organization
cases.scope: Create nested bins, rename, assign media, reopen, search each bin, move and delete empty folders. Duplicate-item UI remains in IN-07.
cases.expected: Stable bin identities, nested scope and media assignments persist; removing empty folders preserves media.

cases.title: Bin soft-delete and restore
cases.scope: Soft-delete a source used on a timeline, render, restore the same source identity and reopen.
cases.expected: Search hides the deleted asset while placed clips remain unchanged and render identically; restore returns the original identity.

cases.title: Markdown document lifecycle
cases.scope: Create and import Markdown documents; inspect saved bytes, rename, reopen and delete one. Rich editing, chips and shortcuts remain manual.
cases.expected: Created/imported documents have independent identities and exact contents; rename persists and deletion targets only the selected document.

cases.title: Mixer gain, mute and solo
cases.scope: Render a known tone through the offline mixer before and after track changes. Mixer widgets and audible monitoring remain manual.
cases.expected: Gain lowers RMS by 6 dB, mute is silent, solo and restored state retain the reference level after reopen.

cases.title: Clip audio gain and undo
cases.scope: Change audio clip gain and measure rendered samples through mix analysis.
cases.expected: RMS falls by 12 dB and undo restores the original level.

cases.title: Native audio EQ and bypass
cases.scope: Apply a 440 Hz EQ cut to the synthetic 440 Hz tone and compare offline rendered audio. External plugins remain manual.
cases.expected: EQ lowers the known tone by more than 10 dB; bypass restores the original RMS.

cases.title: Offline loudness analysis
cases.scope: Render four seconds of known audio and verify reported sample count, RMS, peak and integrated loudness. Live playback meters remain manual.
cases.expected: Exactly 192,000 samples render at 48 kHz with fixture-reference RMS/peak and finite integrated loudness.

cases.title: Primary saturation render, save and reset
cases.scope: Add a primary grade and adjust saturation through graph operations. Wheels, model selector and panel interactions remain manual.
cases.expected: Neutral pixels match the reference, saturation reduces chroma, edits persist after reopening, and reset restores pixels.

cases.title: Tone contrast render, save and reset
cases.scope: Edit a Tone node S-Contrast value and render before/after. Individual zone controls and panel interactions remain manual.
cases.expected: The edit changes pixels, persists after reopening and resetting contrast restores reference pixels.

cases.title: Balance exposure render, save and reset
cases.scope: Edit exposure in a Balance node through graph operations; GUI controls and white balance remain manual.
cases.expected: Positive exposure brightens rendered pixels, persists after reopening and reset restores the reference.

cases.title: Working colour-space change and undo
cases.scope: Switch the working colour space to ACEScg, render, then undo once.
cases.expected: The requested setting is active and renders; one undo restores the prior setting and reference pixels.

cases.title: Procedural matte connection and undo
cases.scope: Create rectangle and Apply Matte nodes, then connect their returned durable identities in one atomic graph edit and render a half-frame mask.
cases.expected: The graph retains the left source pixels and blacks out the right; one undo restores the complete frame.

cases.title: Chained effects and independent bypass
cases.scope: Chain blur and exposure, render the combined result, then bypass each independently. UI Inspector controls remain manual.
cases.expected: Blur smooths edges, exposure brightens the blurred image, and bypassing each restores the expected preceding result.

cases.title: Independent timeline duplication
cases.scope: Duplicate a timeline through the operation surface, edit the copy and reopen. Clipboard and tab UI remain manual.
cases.expected: Sources and timing copy into independent identities; editing the duplicate leaves the original unchanged.

cases.title: Clip speed change and undo
cases.scope: Retime a clip to double speed without ripple, then undo.
cases.expected: The source window is preserved, timeline duration halves, later content stays fixed and undo restores timing.

cases.title: Save As and project-copy independence
cases.scope: Save a populated project to a new owned bundle, edit the copy and inspect the original. File dialogs remain manual.
cases.expected: The saved copy preserves project content and editing it leaves the original unchanged.

cases.title: Decode source audio and waveform data
cases.scope: Extract a known two-second tone through the packaged media operation and measure samples, frequency and waveform envelope. Visible waveform/filmstrip UI remains separate.
cases.expected: Exactly 32,000 finite 16 kHz mono samples contain the known 440 Hz tone.

cases.title: Detected source colour and ingest transform
cases.scope: Detect video/still input colour using the installed rules; compare the ingested clip transform. UI column presentation remains separate.
cases.expected: The expected colour encodings, provenance and confirmation status are returned; the clip uses the detected encoding.

cases.title: Missing local source and recovery
cases.scope: Move an owned source away, reopen, verify missing media, restore the original path and reopen. Choosing a different relink path remains separate.
cases.expected: Missing media is reported while asset and clip identity remain stable; restoring the file restores rendered pixels.

cases.title: RGB curve render and persistence
cases.scope: Change master curve control points, reopen and remove the override. Curve widgets and clipboard remain separate.
cases.expected: Control points and changed pixels persist; resetting the curve restores the baseline.

cases.title: Hue curve render and persistence
cases.scope: Change hue-versus-saturation curve points, reopen and reset. Curve widgets and clipboard remain separate.
cases.expected: The hue curve changes rendered pixels, persists and resets to the baseline.

cases.title: White balance temperature and tint
cases.scope: Change temperature and tint through a native graph node, then reset/undo. Panel widgets remain separate.
cases.expected: Temperature and tint each affect pixels; neutral temperature and tint undo restore the reference.

cases.title: Copy grade values between independent clips
cases.scope: Read a grade and recreate its type/parameters on another clip through shared helpers. Clipboard routing remains separate.
cases.expected: The copy reproduces pixels and editing it leaves the original grade intact after reopen.

cases.title: Render six grades on one clip
cases.scope: Render six connected native grades and bypass all six. Retain elapsed time; real-time playback remains separate.
cases.expected: All six grades affect the image and bypass restores source pixels.

cases.title: Render six overlapping graded tracks
cases.scope: Stack six graded clips, render, hide the top clip and undo. Playback rate remains separate.
cases.expected: Six layers render, hiding the top reveals the lower grade and undo restores it.

cases.title: Random access across twenty cuts
cases.scope: Export twenty alternating clips in a back-and-forth order against known reference frames. GUI scrubbing and real-time playback remain separate.
cases.expected: Every requested frame matches its intended source; no stale frames appear.

cases.title: Reopen twenty timelines with 500 clips
cases.scope: Construct twenty timelines with 25 clips each, checkpoint/reopen and verify all contents. Record headless open time; GUI latency and cross-build performance acceptance remain separate.
cases.expected: All 500 clips retain identities, source windows and timeline positions after reopen.

cases.title: Fifty-step edit history
cases.scope: Perform fifty edits across two timelines, undo all and redo all with state checks and timings. GUI responsiveness remains separate.
cases.expected: Every undo/redo exactly reproduces the corresponding recorded state.

cases.title: Copy one hundred clips across frame rates
cases.scope: Copy 100 clips from 24 fps to 25 fps and undo the copy. Clipboard UI, fractional rounding and performance baseline remain separate.
cases.expected: All copies have independent IDs, exact timing and sources; undo removes only the copies.

cases.title: Nested timeline rendering and child edits
cases.scope: Build two levels of ordinary timeline references; render child edits, undo/redo and reopen. Compound UI authoring and live playback remain separate.
cases.expected: Parent and grandparent renders follow the child edit and undo; references, exact content and edited pixels survive reopening.

cases.title: Mixed-codec timeline rendering
cases.scope: Ingest ProRes, H.264 and MXF, place consecutive cuts and seek out of order. Still-image admission, MGFX and live playback/drop measurement remain separate.
cases.expected: Each cut renders pixels matching an independent source decode; seeking back selects the intended media.

cases.title: Render media across integer and fractional rates
cases.scope: Render a 24 fps clip on 25, 24000/1001 and 30000/1001 timelines using exact frame addressing. Live cadence and A/V sync remain separate.
cases.expected: Each timeline retains its exact rational rate and resolves the requested frame to the expected source image.

cases.title: Fractional-rate copy, undo and persistence
cases.scope: Copy a 24-frame 24000/1001 span to frames 3–33 at 30000/1001, undo/redo and reopen. Clipboard routing remains separate.
cases.expected: The copy has independent identity, exact fractional bounds and source window; undo removes only the copy and redo persists.

cases.title: Linked cut audio and video continuity
cases.scope: Split linked video/audio and compare offline samples and frames immediately around the cut. Live A/V sync remains separate.
cases.expected: Both streams retain contiguous source ranges and links, audio sample count/peak with RMS within 0.01 dB, and identical frames before/on/after the cut.

cases.title: Bulk local ingest of 201 video assets
cases.scope: Register 201 tiny synthetic videos and ingest in bounded batches with model analysis disabled. Verify all sidecars after reopen and sampled search/path identities. UI scrolling during ingest remains separate.
cases.expected: All 201 independent source identities have completed current ingest evidence after reopen; sampled search returns the intended asset.

deferred.LP-02: Desktop app lifecycle remains a GUI check; A-LP-02 covers the packaged headless engine only.
deferred.CLI-01: Embedded GUI endpoint requires a separate desktop session contract; A-CLI-01 covers the shipped headless endpoint.
deferred.CLI-02: A server readback alone cannot prove the visible editor adopted a CLI edit; needs an independent GUI observation.
deferred.IN-07: A-IN-07-B and A-IN-07-D cover folder organization and asset soft-delete/restore. General item duplicate/rename UI remains manual.
deferred.IN-08: A-IN-08-R tests missing local source and restoration at the original path. No explicit different-path relink operation is exposed.
deferred.SS-07: A-SS-07 covers project, asset and bin scope; observing search independently of GUI timeline focus remains manual.
deferred.SB-03: No Spellbook operation group in the selected package schema.
deferred.SB-12: No Spellbook operation group in the selected package schema.
deferred.EX-02: The CLI exposes still export, not a movie-export job contract or unset-rate fallback oracle.
deferred.A-IN-04: A-IN-04-T verifies thumbnails; A-IN-04-W verifies decoded PCM and waveform data. Filmstrip/waveform display and cache integration remain separate.
deferred.A-TL-08: A nested timeline reference is not proof of the application's compound creation and editing path.
deferred.A-CO-08: Needs a source-colour override contract and independent rendered-pixel checks.
deferred.A-SB-06: No Spellbook run/delivery operation group in the selected package schema.
deferred.A-EX-01: No bounded movie-export job contract in the installed CLI surface; FFmpeg encoding alone would not test Wizard export.

preparation.scope: Local video source preparation plus a synthetic speech fixture and pinned cached CoreML ASR model. Speech checks explicitly opt into offline ASR; all other model analysis and downloads disabled.
